scope: Fixed static/API-header and generator source materials for shaderc, Vulkan Loader, libplacebo and OpenCL ICD Loader, not additional runtime DLL owners, a linked SBOM, historical rebuild, final notices or distribution approval.

package_signature_verification.scope: All ten original package detached signatures verified locally using existing MSYS2 public keys. The offline collector rechecks fixed input hashes, not signatures. Original source archive signatures were not verified.

limitations: GCC and GCC-libs 16.1.0-5 are recorded build inputs; existing GCC 16.2 runtime materials do not replace their static/compiler scope.

glslang 16.3.0-1 records SPIRV-Tools 3~1.4.350.1-1, whose original source, build recipe and public headers are now preserved separately. Shaderc itself records SPIRV-Tools 3~1.4.357.0-1; do not infer a second old implementation at final link.
Preserve glslang's actual generated Bison 3.8.2 parser and explicit exception despite its root license introduction saying Bison was removed; retain additional NVIDIA and inherited header terms.
Source-only tools, tests and documentation notices are retained without automatically assigning all of them to the runtime DLL.

components.name: spirv-tools-glslang-build
components.usage: Observed public-header input to glslang; not evidence of a second SPIRV-Tools implementation linked into shaderc. Four installed headers match original source. Their includes reference C/C++ standard headers and each other, not SPIRV-Headers grammar data.
